_about: Example clauses with their ratings on Presolv360's scale. The clauses are made up: they follow the wording of real dispute clauses but name no real lender. Only the sentence that decides the rating is quoted; full clauses are in tests/fixtures/clauses.

examples.source: Example clause: Presolv360 named as the institution
examples.deciding_wording: …effect and / or validity thereof ("Dispute"), shall be resolved by arbitration, administered electronically by Presolv360, an independent institution, in accordance with its Dispute Resolution Rules ("Rules").

examples.source: Example clause: Presolv360 named, short form
examples.deciding_wording: …the parties under this agreement shall be finally resolved by arbitration administered electronically by Presolv360 under its rules for the time being in force, before a sole arbitrator appointed under those rules.

examples.source: Example clause: Presolv360 or another named ODR institution, chosen by the initiating party
examples.note: Presolv360 listed with another named ODR institution is one way of picking, rated 5/5.
examples.deciding_wording: …electronically and as chosen by the party initiating the arbitration when a dispute arises, by either one of the following arbitration institutions: 1. Presolv360 (Presolv), an online dispute resolution platform;

examples.source: Example clause: Presolv360 or any other ODR platform
examples.note: Presolv360 5/5 or any other ODR platform 4/5, so the average is 4.5/5.
examples.deciding_wording: …shall address a notice to the other party ("Respondent") suggesting the name of one of the following ODR platforms (Designated Institution) as stated below or any other ODR platform: - Presolv360 ODR Institution;

examples.source: Example clause: Any online dispute resolution forum, not named
examples.deciding_wording: …meaning, scope or validity, termination or breach shall be referred to and resolved by arbitration, administered electronically, by a sole arbitrator to be appointed by any online dispute resolution forums ("ODR").

examples.source: Example clause: Lender nominates, and 'notwithstanding' an ODR route
examples.note: Part (i) lets the lender nominate the arbitrator (2/5) and part (ii) uses an ODR institution (4/5), so the average is 3/5. The 'notwithstanding' does not override part (i).

examples.source: Example clause: Mutual consent from the lender's 3 names; hearings may be online
examples.note: Hearings may be held online, but that does not change who picks the arbitrator, so it stays 3/5.
examples.deciding_wording: …as per the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. (ii) The Parties hereby agree that all disputes shall be referred to and adjudicated by the sole arbitrator to be mutually appointed by the Parties.

examples.source: Example clause: Mutual consent from amongst 3 arbitrators referred by the lender
examples.deciding_wording: …1996, or any statutory amendments thereof administered electronically/physically, by the sole arbitrator to be appointed by mutual consent of the parties, from and amongst the 3 Arbitrators as referred by the Lender.

examples.source: Example clause: Arbitrator nominated or appointed by the lender
examples.deciding_wording: …with the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 or any statutory amendments thereof and the same shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator to be nominated/ appointed by the Lender.

examples.source: Example clause: Sole arbitrator nominated by the lender
examples.deciding_wording: …shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, or any statutory amendments thereof and shall be referred to a Sole Arbitrator nominated by the Lender.
